package registration

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/viant/datly/standalone"
	"github.com/viant/datly/standalone/config"
	upstream "github.com/viant/mcp"
	"github.com/viant/mcp-protocol/authorization"
	oauthmeta "github.com/viant/mcp-protocol/oauth2/meta"
	"github.com/viant/mcp-protocol/schema"
	mcpclient "github.com/viant/mcp/client"
)

func TestGeneratedHandlerCaseFormat(t *testing.T) {
	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	const expected = `{"accountInfo":{"accountName":"one:two","enabled":false,"recordCount":0,"KeepThisName":"explicit"},"accounts":[{"accountName":"one:two","enabled":false,"recordCount":0,"KeepThisName":"explicit"}],"missing":null}`
	for _, mode := range []string{"indexed", "eager"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			cfg := &config.Config{BaseDir: filepath.Dir(cwd), GoBootstrap: &config.Packages{Packages: []string{"github.com/viant/datly/handlerfixture/registration"}, EagerComponents: mode == "eager"}, Endpoint: config.Endpoint{Address: "127.0.0.1:0"}, MCP: &config.MCP{Address: "127.0.0.1:0"}}
			cfg.MCP.Authorization = &authorization.Policy{Tools: map[string]*authorization.Authorization{}}
			for _, tool := range []string{"Convert", "Reference"} {
				cfg.MCP.Authorization.Tools[tool] = &authorization.Authorization{ProtectedResourceMetadata: &oauthmeta.ProtectedResourceMetadata{Resource: "https://test.invalid/" + tool}}
			}
			server, err := standalone.New(ctx, standalone.Options{Config: cfg, Holders: []any{ConvertDatly, &Reference{}}})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			done := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() { done <- server.Serve(ctx, io.Discard) }()
			t.Cleanup(func() {
				cancel()
				require.NoError(t, server.Shutdown(context.Background()))
				require.NoError(t, <-done)
			})
			addresses, err := server.WaitReady(ctx)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			for _, route := range []string{"/convert", "/reference"} {
				request := httptest.NewRequest("POST", route, strings.NewReader(`{"inclusion":"one","exclusion":"two"}`))
				request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				request.Header.Set("Authorization", "allowed")
				response := httptest.NewRecorder()
				server.ServeHTTP(response, request)
				require.Equal(t, 200, response.Code, response.Body.String())
				require.JSONEq(t, expected, response.Body.String(), route)
			}
			client, err := upstream.NewClientWithContext(ctx, nil, &upstream.ClientOptions{Name: "test", Version: "1", ProtocolVersion: schema.LatestProtocolVersion, Transport: upstream.ClientTransport{Type: "streamable", ClientTransportHTTP: upstream.ClientTransportHTTP{URL: "http://" + addresses[1] + "/mcp"}}})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			defer client.Close()
			for _, tool := range []string{"Convert", "Reference"} {
				result, err := client.CallTool(ctx, &schema.CallToolRequestParams{Name: tool, Arguments: map[string]any{"Inclusion": "one", "Exclusion": "two"}}, mcpclient.WithAuthToken("allowed"))
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.False(t, result.IsError != nil && *result.IsError, "%+v", result)
				data, err := json.Marshal(result.StructuredContent)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.JSONEq(t, expected, string(data), tool)
			}
		})
	}
}
